_about: Client roster read by jobs/client_scorecard.py. This file is the SEED; the running roster lives in the store under client:<slug> keys and the job merges the two (store wins, so a correction made in the store is not overwritten by a re-run). The eventual source of truth is the ClickUp Active Clients list 901421193684 plus its 'Scorecard slug' custom field, once a ClickUp token exists.

_fields.slug: lowercase hyphenated, matches the Drive folder and the ClickUp 'Scorecard slug' field
_fields.start_date: day 0 of the term. Day 0 is the KICKOFF CALL, not the Won date; start_basis records which one this actually is
_fields.term_days: length of the term; term_end is derived and must agree
_fields.deal_type: performance | setup_plus_monthly | flat. performance deals invoice against the scorecard, so attribution_window_days is required for them
_fields.attribution_window_days: a contact that signs within this many days of its FIRST sequence touch counts. 180 for reactivation, per config/offers.md
_fields.instantly_campaign_ids: campaigns run on this client's behalf. Empty means the scorecard has no send data and says so rather than printing zeros as if they were measured
_fields.value_per_close_usd: used only to ESTIMATE revenue while there is no GHL token; every estimated figure is labelled in the scorecard
_fields.review_link: where the day-30 review ask points
